scanNote:
WORKBOOK 1-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (4-bet). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda oq 'UNIT 1', yonida katta qora 'People around the World'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary' (to'q sariq doira belgisi):
1) 'Fill in the correct adjectives from the lists, then underline the phrases which justify each person's character.'
  Qiya: 'clever, brave'. A (Sean Connery surati - James Bond, orqada suvga sakrayotgan figura): 'Sean Connery is famous for his role as James Bond in the early 007 movies. James Bond is 1) ........ because he deals with many dangerous people. He is also 2) ........ . He always thinks of a way to get out of difficult situations and is always the one who wins.'
  Qiya: 'stubborn, selfish, determined'. B (Whitney Houston surati): 'Whitney Houston plays the role of Rachel Marron in the film The Bodyguard. Rachel is 1) ........; she doesn't think of anyone but herself. She is 2) ........ because she wants to be the best, but this also makes her 3) ........ . She never listens to other people when they give her advice.'
  Qiya: 'mysterious, suspicious'. C (David Duchovny surati): 'David Duchovny is famous for playing Agent Mulder in the TV series The X-Files. Mulder is a 1) ........ person; he doesn't trust other people. He is also 2) ........, and even those close to him don't know everything about him.'
  Qiya: 'independent, sensible'. D (Gillian Anderson surati): 'Gillian Anderson plays the role of Agent Scully in The X-Files. Scully is a(n) 1) ........ woman, who thinks for herself and makes her own decisions. Scully is very 2) ........ . She doesn't like taking dangerous risks.'

O'NG USTUN:
2) 'Fill in: jealous, rude, talkative, shy, mean, honest.' 1 Sally is a very ........ person. She never tells lies. 2 Bill is a quiet boy. He's quite ........ . 3 Robert always wants what others have. He's a very ........ person. 4 Susan is a ........ person. She's rarely quiet. 5 Jack never spends any money. He's ........ . 6 Phil has bad manners. He's very ........ .
3) 'Match the adjectives to the reasons, then use them to describe your friends and relatives, as in the example.' Pushti quti: 1 friendly, 2 generous, 3 kind, 4 happy, 5 calm, 6 serious, 7 stubborn, 8 polite; a give a lot to people, b make other people feel relaxed, c like talking to other people, d have good manners, e not laugh very often, f always think of other people, g smile a lot, h never change his/her mind. Strelka: 1 → c. Qiya namuna: 'Ted is very friendly. He likes talking to other people.'
4) 'Choose words from the table below to describe the people in the pictures, as in the example.' JADVAL: age: (very) young, middle-aged, old; hair: short, long, curly, straight, wavy, dark; other features: beard, moustache, glasses, friendly smile, dark/fair complexion, wrinkles. TO'RT SURAT: Lisa (yosh qizcha, uzun tekis qora soch, oq yuz), Peter (keksa erkak, oq soch, ko'zoynak, ajinlar), Mike (yosh erkak, kalta qora soch, soqol va mo'ylov), Sara (keksa ayol, kalta jingalak soch, ko'zoynak, ajinlar, kulyapti, to'q yuz). Qiya namuna: 'Lisa is very young, with long straight dark hair. She has got a fair complexion.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '4'.

⚠ Suratlar manbai (3-betdagi Acknowledgements): kino kadrlari.

exercises.explanationUz:
XARAKTER SIFATLARI - MATN ORQALI.

  ⚠ Har bo'shliqdan KEYIN kelgan gap
  sifatni ASOSLAYDI (justify) - shu
  gapning tagiga chiziladi.


TO'RT KINO QAHRAMONI:

  A James Bond (Sean Connery) -
    brave, clever
  B Rachel Marron (Whitney Houston,
    'The Bodyguard' 1992) - selfish,
    determined, stubborn
  C Agent Mulder (David Duchovny,
    'The X-Files') - suspicious,
    mysterious
  D Agent Scully (Gillian Anderson,
    'The X-Files') - independent,
    sensible


⚠ 'BRAVE' va 'CLEVER':

  brave = jasur (xavfdan qo'rqmaydi)
  clever = aqlli (yo'l topadi)


⚠ 'SELFISH' / 'DETERMINED' /
  'STUBBORN':

  selfish = xudbin (faqat o'zini
    o'ylaydi)
  determined = qat'iyatli (maqsadga
    intiladi - IJOBIY)
  stubborn = qaysar (maslahatga
    quloq solmaydi - SALBIY)

  ⚠ 'determined' va 'stubborn' bir
  tanganing ikki tomoni!


⚠ 'SUSPICIOUS' / 'MYSTERIOUS':

  suspicious = shubhalanuvchi
    (odamlarga ishonmaydi)
  mysterious = sirli (u haqida
    hamma narsa ma'lum emas)


⚠ 'INDEPENDENT' / 'SENSIBLE':

  independent = mustaqil (o'zi
    qaror qiladi)
  sensible = oqilona, ehtiyotkor
    (xavfli tavakkal qilmaydi)
  ⚠ 'sensitive' (sezgir) bilan
  adashtirmang!


⚠ 'A(N)' - D matnida:

  'a(n) independent woman' → unli
  bilan boshlangani uchun 'AN
  independent'.


⚠ 'TO DEAL WITH':

  = ... bilan ish ko'rmoq, kurashmoq.


⚠ 'TO TRUST':

  = ishonmoq (odamga).


⚠ 'TO TAKE RISKS':

  = tavakkal qilmoq. 'take' bilan!

items.textEn: A1: James Bond is ___ because he deals with many dangerous people.
items.hintUz: clever / brave - xavfli odamlar bilan ish ko'radi
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tagiga chiziladi: 'he deals with many dangerous people' - jasurlik.

items.textEn: A2: He is also ___ . He always thinks of a way to get out of difficult situations and is always the one who wins.
items.hintUz: clever / brave - har doim yo'l topadi
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tagiga chiziladi: 'always thinks of a way to get out of difficult situations' - aql.

items.textEn: B1: Rachel is ___; she doesn't think of anyone but herself.
items.hintUz: stubborn / selfish / determined - faqat o'zini o'ylaydi
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tagiga chiziladi: 'doesn't think of anyone but herself' - xudbinlik.

items.textEn: B2: She is ___ because she wants to be the best.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tagiga chiziladi: 'wants to be the best' - qat'iyat.

items.textEn: B3: ... but this also makes her ___ . She never listens to other people when they give her advice.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tagiga chiziladi: 'never listens to other people when they give her advice' - qaysarlik.

items.textEn: C1: Mulder is a ___ person; he doesn't trust other people.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tagiga chiziladi: 'doesn't trust other people' - shubha.

items.textEn: C2: He is also ___, and even those close to him don't know everything about him.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tagiga chiziladi: 'even those close to him don't know everything about him' - sirlilik.

items.textEn: D1: Scully is a(n) ___ woman, who thinks for herself and makes her own decisions.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Tagiga chiziladi: 'thinks for herself and makes her own decisions' - mustaqillik.
⚠ 'AN independent' - unli.

items.textEn: D2: Scully is very ___ . She doesn't like taking dangerous risks.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Tagiga chiziladi: 'doesn't like taking dangerous risks' - oqilonalik.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: jealous, rude, talkative, shy, mean, honest.
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'ying: jealous, rude, talkative, shy, mean, honest.
exercises.explanationUz:
COURSEBOOK 8-BET 14-MAShQ SIFATLARI.

  honest    = halol (yolg'on
    gapirmaydi)
  shy       = uyatchan (kamgap)
  jealous   = hasadgo'y (boshqalar-
    nikini xohlaydi)
  talkative = sergap (kam jim turadi)
  mean      = xasis (pul sarflamaydi)
  rude      = qo'pol (odobsiz)


⚠ HAR GAPNING IKKINChI QISMI
  SABAB - shunga qarab tanlanadi.


⚠ 'QUITE' va 'QUIET':

  quite /kwaɪt/ = ancha, juda
  quiet /ˈkwaɪət/ = jim, kamgap
  ⚠ 2-gapda IKKALASI ham bor:
  'a QUIET boy. He's QUITE shy.'


⚠ 'RARELY':

  = kamdan-kam. 'She's rarely quiet'
  = u kamdan-kam jim turadi →
  sergap.


⚠ 'MANNERS':

  = odob, xulq. 'bad manners' =
  odobsizlik → rude.


⚠ 'TO TELL LIES':

  = yolg'on gapirmoq ('say' EMAS).

items.sentence: Sally is a very ___ person. She never tells lies.
items.uz: Salli juda halol odam. U hech qachon yolg'on gapirmaydi.

items.sentence: Bill is a quiet boy. He's quite ___ .
items.uz: Bill kamgap bola. U ancha uyatchan.

items.sentence: Robert always wants what others have. He's a very ___ person.
items.uz: Robert har doim boshqalardagi narsani xohlaydi. U juda hasadgo'y odam.

items.sentence: Susan is a ___ person. She's rarely quiet.
items.uz: Syuzan sergap odam. U kamdan-kam jim turadi.

items.sentence: Jack never spends any money. He's ___ .
items.uz: Jek hech qachon pul sarflamaydi. U xasis.

items.sentence: Phil has bad manners. He's very ___ .
items.uz: Filning odobi yomon. U juda qo'pol.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the adjectives to the reasons, then use them to describe your friends and relatives, as in the example. Example: Ted is very friendly. He likes talking to other people.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarni sabablarga moslang, so'ng ular bilan do'stlaringiz va qarindoshlaringizni tasvirlang, namunadagidek. Namuna: Ted juda samimiy. U boshqalar bilan gaplashishni yaxshi ko'radi.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFAT + SABAB.

  ⚠ Coursebook 8-bet 14-mashq qolipi:
  ISM + is (very) + SIFAT. + SABAB.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (strelka 1 → c):
  'Ted is very friendly. He likes
   talking to other people.'


⚠ SABAB GAPIDA FE'L 3-ShAXS:

  Ro'yxatda: 'give', 'make', 'like'
  Gapda: 'gives', 'makes', 'likes'
  ⚠ 'not laugh' → 'doesn't laugh'


⚠ 'GENEROUS' ≠ 'MEAN':

  generous = saxiy (ko'p beradi)
  mean = xasis (2-mashq).


⚠ 'KIND':

  = mehribon (boshqalarni o'ylaydi).
  ⚠ 'selfish' (1-mashq) ning AKSI.


⚠ 'CALM':

  = xotirjam. /kɑːm/ - 'l' O'QILMAYDI!


⚠ 'TO CHANGE ONE'S MIND':

  = fikrini o'zgartirmoq.
  'never changes his mind' → stubborn
  (1-mashqdagi Rachel kabi).


⚠ 'POLITE' ≠ 'RUDE':

  polite = odobli (good manners)
  rude = qo'pol (bad manners).

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 1 → c. Kitobda strelka bilan - NAMUNA.
'Ted is very friendly. He likes talking to other people.'

⚠ 2 → a. 'mean' (xasis) ning aksi.
'My uncle is very generous. He gives a lot to people.'

⚠ 3 → f. 'selfish' ning aksi.
'My mother is very kind. She always thinks of other people.'

⚠ 4 → g.
'My sister is very happy. She smiles a lot.'

⚠ 5 → b. /kɑːm/ - 'l' o'qilmaydi.
'My father is very calm. He makes other people feel relaxed.'

⚠ 6 → e. Gapda: 'doesn't laugh very often'.
'My teacher is very serious. He doesn't laugh very often.'

⚠ 7 → h. 'to change one's mind' = fikrini o'zgartirmoq.
'My brother is very stubborn. He never changes his mind.'

⚠ 8 → d. 'rude' ning aksi.
'My cousin is very polite. She has good manners.'

modelAnswersUz: Amakim juda saxiy. U odamlarga ko'p beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the table below to describe the people in the pictures, as in the example. age: (very) young, middle-aged, old; hair: short, long, curly, straight, wavy, dark; other features: beard, moustache, glasses, friendly smile, dark/fair complexion, wrinkles. Pictures: Lisa, Peter, Mike, Sara.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvaldan so'zlarni tanlab suratdagi odamlarni tasvirlang, namunadagidek. yosh: (juda) yosh, o'rta yoshli, keksa; soch: kalta, uzun, jingalak, tekis, to'lqinsimon, qora; boshqa belgilar: soqol, mo'ylov, ko'zoynak, samimiy tabassum, to'q/oq yuz rangi, ajinlar. Suratlar: Lisa, Peter, Mike, Sara.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAShQI QIYOFA (coursebook 8-bet
  12-mashq jadvali qisqartirilgan).

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Lisa is very young, with long
   straight dark hair. She has got
   a fair complexion.'


⚠ QOLIP:

  [ISM] is [YOSh], with [SOCh] hair.
  He/She has got [BELGI].

  ⚠ 'with' + soch tavsifi.
  ⚠ 'has got' + soqol/mo'ylov/
  ko'zoynak/ajinlar/tabassum.


⚠ SOCh SIFATLARI TARTIBI:

  uzunlik + shakl + rang:
  'long straight dark hair'
  'short curly grey hair'


⚠ SURATLAR:

  Lisa  - juda yosh qizcha, uzun
    tekis qora soch, oq yuz
  Peter - keksa erkak, kalta oq
    (grey) soch, ko'zoynak, ajinlar
  Mike  - yosh erkak, kalta qora
    soch, soqol va mo'ylov
  Sara  - keksa ayol, kalta jingalak
    soch, ko'zoynak, ajinlar, samimiy
    tabassum, to'q yuz


⚠ 'COMPLEXION':

  = yuz rangi (teri rangi).
  fair complexion = oq yuz
  dark complexion = to'q (qoramtir)
  yuz.


⚠ 'WRINKLES':

  = ajinlar (keksalarda).


⚠ 'GLASSES' - KO'PLIK:

  'He wears glasses' / 'He has got
  glasses'. ⚠ 'a glasses' - XATO.
